item.title: It’s confirmed: Pope Leo XIV will make historic first papal visit to Monaco
item.description: A sitting pope has not visited Monaco in the modern era. That changes on 28th March, when Pope Leo XIV makes an Apostolic Visit to the Principality at the invitation of Prince Albert II.

item.title: MSR Jbonet: The firm behind Monaco’s most familiar places
item.description: Most people rarely notice the furniture around them - the reception counters at a hospital, the dividers in a school corridor, the seating in a conference hall. And yet these elements quietly shape our daily lives.

item.title: Key points from President Donald Trump’s record-long State of the Union address
item.description: It was a sprawling, combative speech that mixed economic self-congratulation with sharp attacks on Democrats, strong foreign policy rhetoric, and a series of symbolic moments that drew both standing ovations and vocal protests from the chamber floor.

item.title: The hottest June ever, a new all-time high and barely any winter — IMSEE’s 2025 weather report is out
item.description: The data published Wednesday by IMSEE confirms what most residents already suspected — 2025 was no ordinary year.

item.title: Monaco Yacht Club to launch first ever Yachting Student Fair this March
item.description: Young people considering a career at sea have a new opportunity to explore what the yachting and maritime industries can actually offer, as the Monaco Yacht Club launches its first ever Yachting Student Fair.

item.title: Europe’s biggest Ethereum conference returns to Cannes with institutions taking centre stage
item.description: EthCC, Europe's largest annual Ethereum conference, returns to Cannes from 30th March to 2nd April for its ninth edition — and this year, the traditional developer community will be joined by a significant new presence: the institutions.

item.title: Ocean warming is decimating fish populations — and the loss is worse than it sounds
item.description: Every tenth of a degree of ocean warming per decade is enough to reduce fish populations by 7.2%. Compounded over time, across entire ocean basins, the numbers become almost impossible to absorb.

item.title: The end of the Champions League for AS Monaco but they come out “with their heads held high”
item.description: Wednesday's match proved to be the end of the Champions League for AS Monaco, with a 2-2 draw against Paris Saint-Germain.

item.title: Princess Grace Irish Library to celebrate St Patrick’s Day with free event
item.description: The Princess Grace Irish Library in Monaco will host a free evening of Irish theatre and music on Thursday 19th March at 7pm to mark St Patrick's Day, giving a fun opportunity for guests to celebrate the day and dress up in green.

item.title: A skier’s worst nightmare played out at Chamonix Tuesday — so why is this alpine winter so deadly?
item.description: An avalanche swept across groomed runs at Chamonix yesterday — and it is far from an isolated incident. This alpine winter has already killed 99 people. Here is what is behind the deadly season.
